headline: Waist-high SSE windswell with onshore building — dawn log session or nothing.
today: Short-period SSE swell around waist-high on a fair angle, so nothing peeling but rideable early. Wind is cross-on at dawn and goes straight onshore and up to 11-14mph through the afternoon, so get it at first light around the incoming tide before it turns to mush. Log or a groveler, keep expectations low.

daysToWatch.note: Period nudges up toward 8s on a fair SSE angle — could push some cleaner sets in early before the cross-on fills in. Best of the stretch.
NW cross-off cleans it up but the swell is small and marginal in angle. Glassy-ish rights maybe, don't expect size.
